The '''Gravity Well Station''' was a type of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based facility that was constructed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was used to stop enemy forces from retreating from the battle via [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==History==
The Gravity Well Station was invented sometime before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was used to stop enemy ships from entering [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The Empire also used generators similar to the Gravity Well Station in the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] and the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]].
